_about: The house voice, in one place (Oct 14, 2026). voiceover.py and voice_take.py read this file; it overrides ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID in .env. Change the voice ONLY here, and only after a dated audition and the owner's ear (see Research Notes/Voice Audition (Oct 14, 2026)/README.md). Command-line flags still override single settings for a test. Oct 19, 2026: profile designed_v4 added (Round 5); primary unchanged until the live A/B in Research Notes/Voice Audition (Oct 19, 2026)/README.md decides.

primary.name: Alex - Upbeat, Energetic and Clear (ElevenLabs Voice Library)
primary.why: Round 3 audition: 224-229 wpm at speed 1.2 (the old hits ran 206-252), the most pitch and loudness variety of the steady voices, numbers +0.9 dB over other words, every test name heard right, the most consistent take to take (0.99). Library terms: rate 1.0, notice period 90 days, already in My Voices.

backup.name: pham v2 (our own clone of the old Shorts' narration), fixed settings
backup.why: F on the owner's listening page (Oct 14): owned by the account, so it can't be withdrawn; closest to the old narration (0.95-0.97). Round 4: 220-236 wpm, cleanest sound (HNR 8.8-10.1), but less consistent (one take of two went flat, 3.8 semitones), hence its pitch gate.

clone_legacy.name: pham v2, the Oct 5-14 production settings (kept only for re-renders of old packages)

pham_v3_test.name: Pham v3 (new instant clone, Oct 14 night, de-duplicated recordings): TESTED, NOT ADOPTED
pham_v3_test.why: Round 4: flattest of all five (pitch variety 3.7-3.8, loudness variety 2.2); kept for reference only

designed_v4.name: MetaSports Designed Narrator v1 (ElevenLabs text-to-voice, owned by the account), Eleven v4
designed_v4.why: Round 5 (Oct 19, Creator plan): tied with Alex at equal pace (pitch variety 4.9-5.1 vs 5.1-5.4; HNR 9.8-9.9 vs 8.6-9.1; WER equal; 2 takes each). v4 reads ~153 wpm with long pauses, so pauses are cut to 0.18 s and the take is stretched to the #42 pace (214 wpm, x1.25). Unique to us (Alex is the most-used library voice: 1.2M clones) and can't be withdrawn. LIVE A/B against Alex on the next #42-format posts decides; until then Alex stays primary.
